introHtml: Custom 33 oz wine glasses offer an oversized capacity that stands out at trade shows, corporate events, and hospitality settings. Unlike standard 12-15 oz options, these large glasses keep beverages cold longer and reduce refills. Decorate with screen printing, etching, or full-wrap designs to maximize brand visibility. Ideal for wineries, resorts, and promotional campaigns looking for a memorable, functional giveaway.
